### [`api.ts`](../../lib/media/api.ts)

### [`focus.ts`](../../lib/media/focus.ts)

- `objectPositionOf` _function_: CSS `object-position` for an image, defaulting to centre.
- `objectPositionForSrc` _function_: CSS `object-position` for a public path — what the cards have to work with.
- `versionedPath` _function_: Any media path with its content version attached — including a pre-cut crop.
- `focusToObjectPosition` _function_: CSS `object-position` for a focal point, defaulting to centre.
- `focusStyle` _function_: Style object for any element painting a media image with `object-fit: cover`.
- `mediaImageProps` _function_: The props every `<Image fill>` / `<Image>` rendering a database image should spread: the path, the intrinsic size that reserves the box, and the focal point.
- `variantFor` _function_: The best variant for a target aspect ratio: the pre-cut crop when one exists, otherwise the source.
- `versioned` _function_: A path with the image's content version attached.
- `versionedSrc` _function_: The image's own path, content-versioned.
- `versionedImageSet` _function_: The aspect-ratio image set for structured data, content-versioned.

### [`geo.ts`](../../lib/media/geo.ts)

- `distanceMeters` _function_: Great-circle distance in metres.
- `nearestPark` _function_: The closest park to a GPS fix, or null when the list is empty.
- `checkParkAssignment` _function_: Compare an image's GPS fix against its assigned park.
- `formatDistance` _function_: Human-readable distance for the admin UI: `840 m`, `12.4 km`.
- `PARK_MATCH_RADIUS_M` _const_: Beyond this, a photo's coordinates are not evidence for the park it is assigned to. Generous on purpose: resorts sprawl, hotel and parking shots are legitimate park images, and a phone's fix under a coaster's steelwork drifts.
- Types: `GeoPark`, `ParkMatch`, `GeoVerdict`

### [`hero-lqip.ts`](../../lib/media/hero-lqip.ts)

- `heroBlurDataUrl` _function_: The inline preview for a hero photo — a 16 px WebP as a `data:` URL, for `next/image`'s `placeholder="blur"`.

### [`hero.ts`](../../lib/media/hero.ts)

- `getHeroMetaBySrc` _function_: Caption data for a hero image by its public path — what the client rotation has.
- `heroImageSrcs` _function_: Public paths of every image eligible for the hero rotation.
- `parkHeroImageSrcs` _function_: Hero images for ONE park — empty when no park is given.
- `heroObjectPosition` _function_: CSS `object-position` for a hero image, defaulting to centre.
- `pickHeroImage` _function_: Deterministic pick keyed to a time window: identical for all concurrent requests, re-picked when the window rolls over. Server-rendered for LCP, so it must not be random per request — that would make the shell uncacheable.
- Types: `HeroImageMeta`

### [`index.ts`](../../lib/media/index.ts)

- `imageCollections` _function_: The folder an image sits in plus every collection its sidecar adds, each once.
- `inCollection` _function_: True when `image` is in `collection` or anywhere below it. `toverland` covers an image filed under `toverland/halloween`, the way a folder would.
- `groupByCollection` _function_: Images by collection id, each under every collection it belongs to and in the order of `images`. An image in two collections is one row listed twice, never a copy.
- `getMediaImage` _function_: One image by id (`toverland/troy`), or null.
- `getMediaImageBySrc` _function_: One image by its public path (`/media/toverland/troy.jpg`), or null.
- `getMediaImageForPath` _function_: The image a public path belongs to, counting the build-time crops.
- `getParkImages` _function_: Every image assigned to a park, in collection + gallery order.
- `getCollection` _function_: Every image in a collection, in gallery order.
- `listCollections` _function_: Every folder collection in the database, sorted. Collections that only a sidecar names are left out on purpose: the admin offers this list as the folder an image can be moved into, and a collection with no folder is not a place to move to.
- `listCollectionNodes` _function_: Every collection id the database knows, as a tree's nodes, with the number of distinct images at or below each one.
- `collectionNodes` _function_: `listCollectionNodes` over any list of images — the part the tests can feed.
- `getParkRef` _function_: Name, city, country and page path of the park an image shows.
- `getParkRefBySlug` _function_: Park reference by slug, for callers that only have one.
- `getParkPagePath` _function_: Locale-less park page path, e.g. `/parks/europe/netherlands/sevenum/toverland`.
- `getParkBackground` _function_: The park's background image — the full-bleed photo on the park page and the OG card. `null` when the park has none, which callers treat as "fall back to the generic background".
- `getRideImage` _function_: The canonical photo for a ride. Prefers the image explicitly marked `ride-card`; falls back to any image of that ride, so a park that has Halloween snapshots of a coaster but no dedicated portrait still shows something.
- `getParkOnlyImages` _function_: Images that belong to a park but to no particular ride — the park-level tier of the database.
- `getRideImages` _function_: Every image showing a given ride, wherever in the tree it is stored.
- `showsRide` _function_: Whether an image is indexed for a ride, as its primary ride or via `alsoRides`.
- `getHeroImages` _function_: The homepage hero rotation pool: images explicitly marked `hero`.
- `getImagesByRole` _function_: Images carrying a role, optionally within one park.
- `searchMedia` _function_: Filter the database. Every field is optional and ANDed together; `q` searches id, slugs, area, tags, credit and all localized alt/caption text at once, so "arachnophobia" finds the photo through its German caption even though nothing else …
- `listTags` _function_: Every distinct tag in the database with its usage count, most-used first.
- `listParks` _function_: Every park slug that has at least one image, with its image count.
- `mediaStats` _function_: Counters the admin browser and the build report both show.
- Re-exports: `./types`, `./manifest-parks`, `./manifest`, `./manifest-search`

### [`photo-backlog.ts`](../../lib/media/photo-backlog.ts)

Which rides in a park still have no photograph, and which of them to shoot first.

- `scoreRide` _function_: The importance of one ride, and the sentence explaining it.
- `buildBacklog` _function_: Sort a park's rides into the three lists the capture screen renders.
- Types: `BacklogRide`, `BacklogReasonKind`, `BacklogReason`, `RankedRide`, `Backlog`

### [`session-photos.ts`](../../lib/media/session-photos.ts)

What the open media session already holds for one park, read off its diff.

- `mediaPath` _function_: `public/media/<collection>/<name>.<ext>`, taken apart.
- `sessionNames` _function_: File names the session occupies in one collection — image and sidecar share one.
- `sessionSidecars` _function_: The sidecars the session adds or changes, in any collection.
- `sidecarFromPatch` _function_: An added file's content, rebuilt from its patch.
- `ridesInSidecars` _function_: The rides a set of sidecars answers for in one park: `ride` and `alsoRides`, the same two fields `showsRide` reads off the index.
- Types: `SessionFile`

### [`suggest.ts`](../../lib/media/suggest.ts)

- `suggestPark` _function_: The park a photo was most likely taken at.
- `suggestRides` _function_: The park's attractions, nearest first — the shortlist the admin offers.
- Types: `GeoAttraction`, `ParkSuggestion`, `RideSuggestion`

### [`text.ts`](../../lib/media/text.ts)

- `countWithText` _function_: How many images carry localized prose at all — the translation-coverage counter.
- `getMediaText` _function_: Raw localized text for an image, unresolved.
- `getMediaAlt` _function_: Alt text in the requested locale, falling back through de → en → anything.
- `getMediaAltBySrc` _function_: Alt text for a PUBLIC PATH rather than a media id, e.g. `/media/europa-park/arthur.jpg?v=0a5e56d1` → the `europa-park/arthur` sidecar.
- `getMediaCaption` _function_: Caption in the requested locale, falling back through de → en → anything.
- `getCreditLine` _function_: Attribution line, e.g. `© 2025 Patrick Arns (CC BY 4.0)`.
- `needsAttribution` _function_: Whether an image needs a visible, on-image credit rather than just the sidecar-only line every photo already carries.
- `resolveMediaImage` _function_: An image with its text resolved for one locale — the shape components render.
- `resolveMediaImages` _function_: `resolveMediaImage` over a list.
